lessons: LIVENESS != CAPABILITY. Every watchdog in this campaign keys on the day file's existence/mtime; both were healthy while the agent could do nothing. Add a pre-07:00 CAPABILITY PROBE (one python -c, one git status, one cheap MCP call) written into ops, and alarm on it the same way a missing session alarms.
Permission grants for an unattended session must live on the launcher command line (version-controlled, reviewable), not in an unversioned user-level allowlist that can be silently lost.
